title: Add five-source arity-four connector cost bound
body:
## Summary

Adds a scoped five-source bound for one paid connector alphabet extension: an atomic arity-four source event `Q_r: z += sum_{j != r} B_j x_j`, charged one dispatch plus all four constituent source-map additions.

For the all-31-nonzero-mask paired-readout batch, the original alphabet has exact 74-query cost, or 148 units under the stated dispatch-plus-addition ledger. Every schedule using the new family costs at least 149 units. The exceptional one-`Q`, nine-source-event branch is exhaustively checked: 23,184 normalized words, maximum prefix-difference set size 26/32. No `kappa` or supplier admission is claimed.

Package: `research/five-source-arity-four-bound/`  
Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`  
Head: `0133b60e`

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/universal-connector-boundary/verify.py` — 945-pairing predecessor control passes.
- `python3.12 -I -O -B research/five-source-arity-four-bound/verify.py` — dirty-call control, 23,184-word census, symmetry controls and twelve-event positive control pass.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-source-arity-four-bound` — registered package replay passes.
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-source-arity-four-bound --check-only` — package metadata and source pins pass.

## Scope and limits

This uses the exact five-source dirty connector and output boundary, with the source alphabet expanded only by weight-four steps. The result uses a uniform linear charge of one unit per event dispatch and one per constituent map addition. It does not price a physical caller's nonuniform source tariffs, word-dependent storage/routing, or an implementation that performs fewer than four charged additions. It is not a complete multiplication theorem or a new selected bound. The selected cold replay and hosted CI were not run or claimed.

Credit Ross Richardson's #943/#934 connector lineage and Cinna Davis's open #2249 high-arity six-source work. #2249 motivated the complementary five-source question but was not independently replayed here. Prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/five-source-arity-four-bound`. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight could not run because this MacBook checkout is shallow and the checker requires full Git history. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
